relay.asks.status.queued.role: queued ask state line with its countdown
relay.asks.status.queued.tone: Preserve casing and the em dash. The duration is a preformatted short token such as <1 m, 42 m, 3 h or 2 d; it is not a placeholder to re-format.
relay.asks.status.queued.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. One line under the ask card's question; rendered from the client clock against expires_at.

relay.asks.status.queued_deadline_passed.role: queued ask state line at or past its deadline
relay.asks.status.queued_deadline_passed.tone: Preserve casing and the em dash. Lowercase start is deliberate: it follows the status word.
relay.asks.status.queued_deadline_passed.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used when the phone clock is past expires_at while the runtime still reports open; it must not claim a countdown.

relay.asks.status.answered.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The answer has been written into the transcript and the agent has been told.

relay.asks.status.delivering.role: settled ask receipt while the response is in flight
relay.asks.status.delivering.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The daemon has not yet confirmed the response rows are delivered; do not strengthen this to 'told'.

relay.asks.status.late.role: settled ask receipt for a late answer
relay.asks.status.late.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The answer arrived after the deadline but was accepted.

relay.asks.status.declined.role: settled ask receipt for a refusal
relay.asks.status.declined.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The agent was told the user declined.

relay.asks.status.dismissed.role: settled ask receipt for a dismissal
relay.asks.status.dismissed.tone: Preserve casing and the em dash.
relay.asks.status.dismissed.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Dismissal sends no reply; this sentence must not imply the agent was told anything.

relay.asks.status.withdrawn.role: settled ask receipt when the agent withdrew the question
relay.asks.status.withdrawn.tone: Preserve casing and the em dash.
relay.asks.status.withdrawn.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The asker, not the user, ended the ask.

relay.asks.status.expired.role: settled ask receipt for an expired ask
relay.asks.status.expired.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Too old to answer; the remedy is to ask the agent again.

relay.asks.status.timed_out.role: state line for an ask that timed out
relay.asks.status.timed_out.tone: Preserve casing and the em dash; 'Timed out' is the shared state word on every surface.
relay.asks.status.timed_out.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Byte-identical to the desktop ASK_STATUS_COPY.timed_out sentence and the collapsed badge's word.

relay.asks.status.lapsed_body.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Names what the agent does after a timeout without claiming a default it may not have used.

relay.asks.card.gone.role: terminal sentence when the ask's conversation no longer exists
relay.asks.card.gone.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase start, em dash; keep 'ask' as the verb/noun the product uses.
relay.asks.card.gone.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Mirrors daemon._ASK_GONE_RESPONSE so the card can state the permanent verdict before a guaranteed refusal.

relay.asks.card.secret_notice.role: reassurance above a secret answer field
relay.asks.card.secret_notice.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase start, em dash.
relay.asks.card.secret_notice.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The answer is sent directly and never written to the transcript.

relay.asks.card.secret_notice_persisted.role: reassurance above a secret answer field that is also saved
relay.asks.card.secret_notice_persisted.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase start, em dash.
relay.asks.card.secret_notice_persisted.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Same fact as the sibling key plus the credential-store write; used only when the question sets persist.

relay.asks.card.placeholder_secret.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The field is masked; a credential is pasted here.

relay.asks.card.placeholder_answer.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used for ordinary questions with no options.

relay.asks.card.recommended.role: badge suffix on a recommended option
relay.asks.card.recommended.tone: Preserve the leading middle dot and the lowercase word.
relay.asks.card.recommended.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Marks the option the model recommends; the dot separates it from the option label.

relay.asks.card.choose_any.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. States that more than one option may be selected.

relay.asks.card.urgent.role: urgent marker beside the state line
relay.asks.card.urgent.tone: Preserve the leading middle dot and the lowercase word.
relay.asks.card.urgent.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Advisory only; it does not change the answer controls.

relay.asks.card.dismiss.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The label is also the control's width; keep it short. Dismissal sends no reply.

relay.asks.card.skip.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Submits an empty list for one question without answering it.

relay.asks.card.unskip.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Reverses the sibling skip control.

relay.asks.card.nothing_left.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Explains that another surface has taken every question; it replaces a permanently disabled send.

relay.asks.card.cold_wait.role: in-flight notice while a stopped session is brought up
relay.asks.card.cold_wait.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase, em dash and the ~30 s bound.
relay.asks.card.cold_wait.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Shown only while answering a cold conversation, where the operation really does cost about 30 seconds.

relay.asks.card.send_answers.role: submit action label for a multi-question ask
relay.asks.card.send_answers.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. One submit answers every question in the form.

relay.asks.card.send_answer.role: submit action label for a single-question ask
relay.asks.card.send_answer.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Singular sibling of send_answers.

relay.asks.card.decline.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Declining answers the agent that the user refused.

relay.asks.card.timed_out_badge.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The disclosure header's state word; the body states what the timeout means.

relay.asks.sheet.title_waiting.role: asks sheet title with a live count
relay.asks.sheet.title_waiting.tone: Preserve the leading section noun and its ' · ' separator, and lowercase. The section noun names the SHEET (asks, approvals and secrets all live here), so a locale must not reuse the question word as the section noun. The count is an ICU plural over questions.
relay.asks.sheet.title_waiting.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Counts questions, not asks, matching the dock and the session header.

relay.asks.sheet.title_lapsed.role: asks sheet title when only lapsed questions remain
relay.asks.sheet.title_lapsed.tone: Preserve the leading section noun and its ' · ' separator, and lowercase. The section noun is the sheet's name, not the question count word.
relay.asks.sheet.title_lapsed.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Lapsed questions are read-only; the title says what the sheet holds.

relay.asks.sheet.title_plain.role: asks sheet title with nothing waiting or lapsed
relay.asks.sheet.title_plain.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase. This is the section noun alone.
relay.asks.sheet.title_plain.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The bare sheet name.

relay.asks.sheet.loading.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase. The ellipsis is U+2026.
relay.asks.sheet.loading.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Prevents the empty state from appearing while the first read is in flight.

relay.asks.sheet.empty.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Shown only after a successful read returns no rows.

relay.asks.sheet.retry.role: retry action after a failed read
relay.asks.sheet.retry.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. A failed read must not leave closing as the only move.

relay.asks.sheet.ended_wait.role: warning before answering in an ended conversation
relay.asks.sheet.ended_wait.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase, em dash, and the ~30 s bound.
relay.asks.sheet.ended_wait.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Answering reopens the conversation; the wait is stated before the tap.

relay.asks.sheet.not_running_wait.role: warning before answering in a stopped conversation
relay.asks.sheet.not_running_wait.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase, em dash, and the ~30 s bound.
relay.asks.sheet.not_running_wait.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Answering brings the runtime up; used when the conversation exists but is not live.

relay.asks.dock.waiting.role: minimized ask chip with a live count
relay.asks.dock.waiting.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase. Count is an ICU plural over questions.
relay.asks.dock.waiting.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The chip counts questions the reader can act on, never asks.

relay.asks.dock.timed_out.role: minimized ask chip when only lapsed questions remain
relay.asks.dock.timed_out.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase. Count is an ICU plural over questions.
relay.asks.dock.timed_out.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Quiet register: the sheet behind the chip is where Dismiss lives.

relay.asks.row.told.role: label over the detail sent to the agent
relay.asks.row.told.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Expands under a settled ask row.

relay.asks.pending.kind_approval.role: pending card kind label for an approval
relay.asks.pending.kind_approval.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The pinned meta row above the approval card's question.

relay.asks.pending.kind_secret.role: pending card kind label for a secret request
relay.asks.pending.kind_secret.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The card masks the value and suppresses keyboard learning.

relay.asks.pending.kind_question.role: pending card kind label for an ordinary question
relay.asks.pending.kind_question.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The default kind in the pinned meta row.

relay.asks.pending.options.role: option-count suffix in the pending meta row
relay.asks.pending.options.tone: Preserve the leading middle dot and lowercase. Count is an ICU plural over options.
relay.asks.pending.options.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. States the total when the card caps its visible options.

relay.asks.pending.question_of.tone: Preserve casing; the words Question/ of are part of the sentence.
relay.asks.pending.question_of.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Index is 1-based and both numbers are integers.

relay.asks.pending.one_of.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used by the older mirrored card shape; count is the total.

relay.asks.pending.remember.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Persists the approval choice for the session.

relay.asks.pending.approve.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The primary action on an approval card.

relay.asks.pending.deny.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Paired with approve.

relay.asks.pending.send.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Submits a typed answer or secret.

relay.asks.error.reach_failed.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used when fetch rejects without a daemon sentence.

relay.asks.error.no_reason.role: refusal fallback with no daemon sentence
relay.asks.error.no_reason.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. A bare HTTP status is not a reason; this names that honestly.

relay.asks.error.read_timeout.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The bounded aggregate read did not answer.

relay.asks.error.session_timeout.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case. Note the typographic apostrophe in didn’t.
relay.asks.error.session_timeout.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The session did not answer within the transport bound.

relay.asks.error.session_gone_reopen.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.error.session_gone_reopen.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Pending card wording; the asks sheet has its own sibling sentence.

relay.asks.error.session_gone_list.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.error.session_gone_list.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Gate sheet wording; it names the session list as the remedy.

relay.asks.error.moved_on.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.error.moved_on.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The card is about to repaint to the current question.

relay.asks.error.already_answered_termin.role: stale tap: answered on the terminal
relay.asks.error.already_answered_termin.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.error.already_answered_termin.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Distinguishes a terminal answer from the waiting sibling.

relay.asks.error.already_answered_waitin.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.error.already_answered_waitin.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used when the daemon reports the question settled or withdrawn.

relay.asks.gate.title.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The sheet controls this session's approval mode.

relay.asks.gate.body.tone: Preserve casing and sentence case. 'Ask' and 'Auto' name the two modes and stay capitalised.
relay.asks.gate.body.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Two sentences: what ask does, what auto does for the rest of the session.

relay.asks.gate.keep_asking.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase; keep the parenthesised mode token (ask).
relay.asks.gate.keep_asking.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Works on an unpaired phone.

relay.asks.gate.run_without.tone: Preserve casing, lowercase; keep the parenthesised mode token (auto).
relay.asks.gate.run_without.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Requires operator authority and pairing.

relay.asks.gate.notice_ask.role: in-sheet receipt after switching to ask mode
relay.asks.gate.notice_ask.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The sheet stays open for this path.

relay.asks.gate.notice_auto.role: session receipt after switching to auto mode
relay.asks.gate.notice_auto.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Rendered on the session header after the sheet closes.

relay.asks.gate.not_paired_error.role: refusal when loosening without a pairing
relay.asks.gate.not_paired_error.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.gate.not_paired_error.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The remedy is one tap away via the pairing prompt.

relay.asks.gate.unpaired_before.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case. This is a sentence fragment completed by the bold labels and the rest of the sibling fragments.
relay.asks.gate.unpaired_before.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The five fragments render as one sentence with two bold mode names; keep the spaces correct at the joins.

relay.asks.gate.unpaired_run_label.role: unpaired warning bold fragment: auto action name
relay.asks.gate.unpaired_run_label.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Bold inline label inside the five-fragment sentence; it names the action that needs pairing.

relay.asks.gate.unpaired_middle.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Sits between the two bold labels; keep the leading space correct at the join.

relay.asks.gate.unpaired_ask_label.role: unpaired warning bold fragment: ask mode name
relay.asks.gate.unpaired_ask_label.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Bold inline label; it names the mode that never needs a pairing.

relay.asks.gate.unpaired_after.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Closes the five-fragment sentence.

relay.asks.gate.operator_refused.role: operator authority refusal with the runtime's sentence
relay.asks.gate.operator_refused.tone: Preserve casing and the backticked command. {message} is the runtime's own sentence and is not reworded.
relay.asks.gate.operator_refused.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The only local addition is the trailing step the machine's refusal cannot know: this surface is the paired phone.

relay.asks.disclosure.held_shut.tone: Preserve casing, sentence case, em dash.
relay.asks.disclosure.held_shut.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. A phone has no hover, so the same rule is also stated in the header row.

relay.asks.disclosure.answer_first.tone: Preserve the leading middle dot and lowercase.
relay.asks.disclosure.answer_first.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Sits beside the chevron; it must stay short enough not to wrap a measured single-line header.

relay.asks.duration.less_than_minute.tone: Preserve the less-than sign and the space; the unit abbreviation may be localized.
relay.asks.duration.less_than_minute.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. A deadline inside the next minute is stated as a bound, never rounded up to '1 m'.

relay.asks.duration.minutes.tone: Keep it short: this sits in a one-line state sentence on a 360px phone. Localize the unit abbreviation; the number is ICU-formatted.
relay.asks.duration.minutes.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. The renderer passes a whole number of minutes; width is measured in the PR.

relay.asks.duration.hours.tone: Keep it short; localize the unit abbreviation.
relay.asks.duration.hours.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used only for deadlines at least 90 minutes away.

relay.asks.duration.days.tone: Keep it short; localize the unit abbreviation.
relay.asks.duration.days.note: Owned relay SPA asks copy. Used only for deadlines at least 48 hours away.
